name: Is it better to hire a professional for drywall sanding or do it myself?

mainEntity.name: Is it better to hire a professional for drywall sanding or do it myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: For smaller repair jobs or minor touch-ups, a do-it-yourself approach to drywall sanding might be feasible. However, for entire rooms, new constructions, or extensive renovations, hiring a professional is often recommended. Professionals have specialized tools, expertise in achieving a level-5 finish (the highest standard), and efficient dust management systems. Incorrect sanding can lead to visible imperfections even after painting, requiring costly rework. A professional ensures a high-quality finish, saves time, and minimizes mess.
acceptedAnswer.description: For large projects or a perfect finish, hire a professional with specialized tools and expertise. DIY is suitable for small repairs, but improper sanding can lead to visible flaws.
